```swift
Text("Rotation by passing an angle in degrees")
    .visualEffect { content, geometryProxy in
        content
            .perspectiveRotationEffect(
                .degrees(45),
                axis: (x: 0.0, y: 1.0, z: 0.0),
                anchor: .center,
                perspective: 1)
        }
    .border(Color.gray)
```
